notes.title: Announcement of the release of "OIHAGI STREAMER SURVIVAL"!
notes.notes:
Starting today, we are offering a launch discount to celebrate the release!
We are offering a 10% discount, so we hope you will take this opportunity to purchase the game.
We hope you will continue to support "OIHAGI STREAMER SURVIVAL.

notes.title: "OIHAGI STREAMER SURVIVAL" release date decided!
notes.notes:
We're sorry for the long wait! The release date for "OIHAGI STREAMER SURVIVAL" has been set for December 12, 2024! 🎉
Add it to your wishlist and wait for this survival game where streamers fight for survival!!

notes.title: Notice of Release Date Postponement
notes.notes:
Notice of Release Date Postponement

We regret to inform you that the release of "OIHAGI STREAMER SURVIVAL," originally scheduled for the near future, has been postponed to later in 2024.

We will provide an update with the new release date as soon as it has been determined.

We sincerely apologize for the delay and ask for your understanding and patience.
